evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: A fact check rated as false the claim that China was the first country to land on the moon's South Pole a few years ago.

outputs.notes_en: The claim is about India being the first country to land on the Moon's south pole. The only relevant fact check contradicts the claim that China was the first to land on the Moon's south pole, which indirectly supports the original claim.
